journal_lines: Black seam in the stone. Wide and consistent.
Coal faces the whole tunnel. Good start.
Charcoal smell before I found it. Then the vein.
A seam of black running the length of the wall, like a river drawn in soot.
Coal that crumbles to powder under the paw. Older than the trees it used to be.
A whole forest pressed thin and dark and patient. Carried what I could.
The dust stayed in the fur for days. Forest under the fur.
Black on the muzzle. Black on the bag. Black is fine.
Easy work, this. The stone forgives the pickaxe here.
A vein wide enough to walk through, if a wolf were so inclined.
Found a seam that brightened when I struck it. The whole wall, briefly lit.
